templates.source: https://www.360visiontechnology.com/wp-content/uploads/dlm_uploads/2016/03/Predator-HD-Installation-Manual-V2.1.23.2.pdf — 360 Vision Predator HD Installation Manual V2.1.23.2, section 'Stream Resolutions & RTSP Links': 'Dual H.264 (rtsp://ipaddress/h264main)'. Same table in the Invictus (V2.1.25.3), Visiondome HD (V2.1.29), Predator (V11) and Predator Radar (V8) installation manuals; RTSP port 554 TCP per the manuals' port table.

https://www.360visiontechnology.com/wp-content/uploads/dlm_uploads/2016/03/Visiondome-HD-Installation-Manual-V2.1.29.pdf — 360 Vision Visiondome HD Installation Manual V2.1.29, section 12 '1080p Stream Resolutions & RTSP Links': 'Dual H.264 (rtsp://ipaddress/h264main) (rtsp://ipaddress/h264sub)'. Same in the Predator HD and Invictus installation manuals.

notes: Paths are documented in the V2.1.x-platform installation manuals (Predator, Predator HD, Predator Radar, Invictus, Visiondome HD). The same manuals also list /mpeg4main, /mpeg4sub and /mjpeg for the MPEG4/MJPEG stream modes. The 2025 V2.3 platform manuals (Predator V2.3.00.29.3, Invictus V2.3.00.29.5) no longer print the path; the web UI shows the stream's RTSP URL with a 'Copy' button under Video settings, so check it there on newer firmware. ONVIF Profile S is the alternative.
